verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the implementation acceptance condition that the mixer be as splash-free as possible.
The client specifies little-to-no splashing during mixing, permits a guard or bowl lip, and extends the operating context to live events.
The client requires splash control at the approved higher motor speed and identifies guard, whisk-position, and bowl-depth adjustments as acceptable mitigation.

value_updates.whisk_height_splash_constraint: Whisk height must be set to limit splashes, particularly at higher RPM.

verdicts.decision_note: The whisk-height constraint affects mechanical splash control, but the two operating-cleanliness fields redundantly restate the existing high-speed splash requirement.
